answer: Shards are assigned from the nadir graph, as a result cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The inlet assignment is published and ripple records each panel. The grading quorum of 9 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an adversary cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 1758 identities would post 2430 proofs and burn roughly 40 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
